# BeamCore Failure Diagnosis Template

## Run-level

- source R7B summary path:
- selected story:
- selected combos:
- actions_source:
- beam_count_processed:
- beam_count_failed:
- diagnosis timestamp:
- branch:
- commit:

BeamCore checks executed; this is not design validation.

## Per-beam diagnosis

For each beam include:

- object_name
- label
- story
- section
- BeamCore status
- observed ETABS actions
- governing combo/station per action
- check_count
- passed_check_count
- failed_check_count
- warning_check_count
- failed checks
- grouped failure categories
- most critical checks
- artifact paths

## Required wording

Use:

- BeamCore checks executed
- failure diagnosis
- observed ETABS actions

Do not use:

- beam designed
- ETABS validated
- design engine validated
- production ready
- code compliance proven
